Bug_Title: Child class methods named for parent class methods should be overrides
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the Child class where the methods doSomething and doSomethingElse are not actually overriding the methods in the Parent class. doSomething is not an override because the Date import is considered different (though in this case, it's not). doSomethingElse is not an override because the Parent method is static.
